title.description: Conventional commit format: type(SCOPE): subject. Required by Python validation in mode=create.

diagram_type.description: Diagram shape best fitting the change. flowchart: data pipeline / control flow. sequence: request/response across services. before_after: refactor where the delta is the point (two subgraphs in one flowchart). state: status/lifecycle transitions.

impact_paragraph.description: One paragraph: what the change introduces/modifies, key toggles or config, fail-safe behavior, observability hooks. No code-quality opinions, no praise.

why_it_matters.description: Bullets framed as business / risk / cost / rollout-safety value.

mermaid.description:
Valid mermaid of the declared diagram_type (flowchart->'flowchart', before_after->'flowchart', sequence->'sequenceDiagram', state->'stateDiagram-v2'). NO fences. ALL node labels double-quoted (A["..."], C{"..."}); NEVER backslash-escape brackets (\[ \] — backslash is not an escape character in mermaid); use
for line breaks. Inside a label write a double quote as #quot; (' only if a single quote is what you meant), and a literal angle bracket as #lt; / #gt; — those are mermaid's own escapes, and a bare is read as an HTML tag and disappears from the rendering. NEVER HTML entities (" < >). Concrete sample data ONLY on the 1-2 edges central to the change, not every edge. Highlight new/changed nodes (classDef + :::changed for flowchart/before_after/state; Note/rect for sequence). Keep it focused: ~4-8 nodes.

ticket_drift.description: Review mode only: true if the diff implements materially less or more than the linked ticket's scope. Omit/false in create mode.

drift_note.description: Review mode only: one factual line on how the diff diverges from ticket scope (e.g. 'ticket asks rate-limit on /pay; not in diff'). Empty when no drift.
